For updateEvent, selectedCalendar becomes undefined where the old code used `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`; for deleteEvent, calendarId becomes undefined and the deletion may hit the wrong/primary calendar. adjudication.rationale: Looking at lines 253-255 in the diff for updateEvent: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;` - When externalCalendarId is falsy (the else branch), the code searches for `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` which would be searching for `cal.externalId === undefined/null`, which will never match any calendar. This means selectedCalendar will be undefined. The same bug exists in deleteEvent at lines 314-316. This is a real logic error - the fallback should likely search by credentialId or use a different approach, not search for an externalId matching the falsy externalCalendarId parameter.
